This was a very good tour
The guide was friendly and informative and adjusted the pace to suit older members of our group
I recommend the night tour as the temperature is much more pleasant for walking around
Lovely to discover little narrow streets we would never have known existed
Thank you to our guide Andrés, we all enjoyed the tour
